subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` as a public opt-in sandbox config contract for preinstalled-skill deployments?
rationale: The option changes a sandbox skill materialization/readability invariant and adds public config surface, so implementation correctness alone does not settle whether this should be a core user-facing knob or a backend capability.

options.title: Accept After Contract Fix
options.body: Keep this PR direction if the setup/preinstall contract is corrected and fresh proof covers both first-use and false-to-true upgrade behavior.

options.title: Move To Backend Capability
options.body: Ask sandbox backends to declare this optimization so users do not manage a new core config flag and path contract manually.

options.title: Pause Core Change
options.body: Leave the linked feature issue open until sandbox owners decide the permanent preinstalled-skill boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept After Contract Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction if the setup/preinstall contract is corrected and fresh proof covers both first-use and false-to-true upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is the public sandbox/config boundary, and recent history ties steipete to adjacent sandbox layout and docs/config work.
